messages.label: /research <topic>
messages.note: Explicit only: code runs research_start; the model is never offered it

messages.label: Commit queued row
messages.note: Stores chat, requester, topic and wants_pdf; one job per chat

messages.label: researchStarted reply
messages.note: Immediate short reply; empty topic gets the researchTopic line

messages.label: tick leases next row
messages.note: A running row requeues once; a second stop marks it failed

messages.label: Plan, search, read
messages.note: Up to 6 queries, 6 searches, 8 page reads; 3 model calls; 120 s cap

messages.label: Pages and mold
messages.note: validateFindings keeps read URLs only; long lists cut; a stopped job falls back to excerpts

messages.label: Store findings, mark done
messages.note: A failed job writes a failure row and the chat gets researchFailed

messages.label: Summary plus PDF offer
messages.note: wantsPdf renders at once; otherwise the offerPdf line stays open 30 min

messages.label: yes or /pdf
messages.note: Only the requester's whole-message answer counts; anything else is ordinary text

messages.label: PDF document
messages.note: An accepted offer renders through renderReport and delivers a MEDIA file
